---
name: "内容纠错 / Content correction"
about: "定义、推理、译文、来源或练习答案 / Definitions, reasoning, translations, sources, or answers"
title: "[Content] "
---

## 位置 / Location

词条 ID、语言、章节或文件路径。 / Unit ID, language, section, or file path.

## 问题与建议 / Problem and proposed correction

摘录必要的短句，说明哪一步有误，以及建议如何修改。 / Quote only the necessary short passage, identify the error, and suggest a correction.

## 依据 / Evidence

原文链接、作者、版本、页码或章节，以及你实际查阅的范围。 / Original URL, author, version, page or section, and what you actually consulted.

## 影响 / Impact

另一语言、案例、公式或练习答案是否也要修改？不确定时直接说明。 / Does this affect the other language, examples, formulas, or answers? State any uncertainty.
